name: What are common layout mistakes to avoid when designing a small living space?

mainEntity.name: What are common layout mistakes to avoid when designing a small living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common layout mistakes in small spaces often include underestimating storage needs, leading to clutter. Another error is neglecting natural light and ventilation, which can make the space feel cramped and stuffy. Poor traffic flow, where furniture blocks pathways or creates awkward movement, can also reduce functionality. Over-furnishing a small area with bulky or unnecessary items is also a frequent pitfall. It's important to avoid fixed layouts that don't allow for flexibility or multi-purpose use, limiting the home's adaptability over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid underestimating storage, neglecting natural light, creating poor traffic flow, and over-furnishing. Also, ensure the layout allows for flexibility and multi-purpose use.
